reasoning.Student A:
The mechanism's key property says my submitted ranking cannot change which schools are in my Obtainable Schools set — that set is fixed given other students' rankings and the schools' priorities. My ranking only decides which school I receive among the schools that are already obtainable for me: I will get the highest-ranked school (in my list) that lies in that fixed Obtainable set.

Given that, there is no advantage to misreporting preferences to try to manipulate which schools are obtainable (I cannot affect that). The only thing my ranking can do is pick my most-preferred school within the Obtainable set. Therefore I should rank sincerely according to my true preferences: z > x > y > w. (Note: even though I have priority 1 at w and y and many applicants favor y, that only affects which schools are in my Obtainable set — it is not something my ranking can change — so I still list schools in true-preference order.)
reasoning.Student B:
Key mechanism point: the set of schools I could possibly be matched with (my "Obtainable Schools") is fixed given others' rankings and schools' priorities, and my own ranking cannot change which schools are in that set. My ranking only determines which school I receive among those obtainable ones — I get the highest-ranked school on my list that lies in the obtainable set.

Given that, the dominant approach is to rank schools in true preference order. Trying to manipulate by ranking a less-preferred but more-competitive school higher cannot expand the obtainable set and therefore cannot lead to a better final assignment than simply putting my true favorite among the obtainable schools first.

Additional facts that support truthful ordering: I have top priority (1) at x and z and lower priority (2) at w and y; most other applicants prefer y > x > w > z, so y is likely more competitive and I have lower priority there. But even with these considerations, since the obtainable set is fixed independently of my ranking, the safest/optimal move is to list my genuine preferences so I get the best school available to me.

Thus I submit my true preference order: z > x > y > w.
